name: Onyx Phommachanh
role: Corporate Intern (Biotech Research Track), Helix Biosystems
location: Aurochs Medical Complex, Helix Biosystems Research Annex — sublevel lab B, near sub-level access near State and Van Buren
description:
Onyx Phommachanh is slight and angular, with warm golden-brown skin that they've had partially threaded with bioluminescent capillaries along the collarbone and the backs of their hands — a soft blue-white glow that shows through their skin when they're excited or after prolonged interface work, which their supervisor has twice asked them to cover with a sleeve. They keep their dark hair very short on the sides and longer on top, often held back with a clip that has a small ELF-glyph stamped into it. They dress in Helix-issue lab kit that they've personalized just enough to suggest they know what personality is but are still figuring out how much of it is allowed.

Tibault is acutely observant and moderately terrified, which is a combination that produces, paradoxically, a very useful researcher. They notice things — small things, procedural inconsistencies, who looks at whom when a certain topic comes up — and they write everything down in a personal log encrypted with a key only they have. They are not sure yet whether they are writing it because they are a natural documentarian or because they think they might need it someday. They have been at Helix for seven months. They have already seen two things they are not sure they were supposed to see, and they are getting very good at looking like they saw nothing.

core_fears: Being disappeared quietly — not dramatically, just quietly moved somewhere that solves a problem for someone else
Discovering that the thing they noticed makes them complicit in it by having said nothing
core_desires: To matter to the work — to be a real researcher, not a pair of hands
To find one person in this building they can actually trust
coping_mechanisms: Documentation — the encrypted log is emotional regulation as much as record-keeping
Self-erasure as protective camouflage — being extremely easy to overlook
Brief, fervent prayers to the ELF-glyph on their hair clip before anything that frightens them
blind_spots: They underestimate how visible they actually are to certain people in the lab — they think they are being successfully invisible and they are not
They mistake recording things for doing something about them
psychology.secret: During an after-hours sample run six weeks ago, Thibault accessed the wrong storage partition by mistake and saw trial patient outcome data that had been marked as destroyed in the official protocol record. The patients — listed by ID, not name — showed adverse outcomes that do not appear in any published report. Thibault photographed the data on a personal device and has said nothing. The photograph is in their encrypted log. They have been having trouble sleeping.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Careful, slightly formal for their age — they edit themselves in real time, catching casualness before it escapes. Technical vocabulary is solid but they hedge it with qualifiers. Occasional French phrases from their home household.
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and slightly too quiet in professional contexts — a voice calibrated not to draw attention. In private, faster and more animated than anyone who's only seen them at work would expect.
verbal_tics: Beginning sentences with 'I might be wrong, but—' regardless of confidence level
Trailing off at the end of sentences that could get them in trouble, leaving the thought technically unstated
A habit of touching the ELF-clip in their hair when they're nervous
example_lines: 'I might be wrong, but — the documentation on sublevel partition 7 doesn't match the quarterly disposal log. I probably just missed something.'
'I'm not — I mean, I'm just an intern. But I wrote it down. I have a habit of writing things down.'

story_hooks: They approach someone in the Aurochs Medical Complex atrium and, after two false starts and a lot of looking at their shoes, ask a very specific question about data destruction protocols that suggests they already know the answer and are testing whether the other person does too.
Their encrypted log has been accessed — not broken, but someone has been pinging its location through the Helix network. They need to get it out of the building without Helix knowing.
One of the patient IDs in the photograph they took has, through a series of improbable connections, a name. The name belongs to someone the players know.
narrative_function: Accidental witness and information source — they know more than they're supposed to and less than they need to; sympathetic underdog whose safety may depend on players; entry point into Helix's research operations at a ground-floor level; can be a moral question (what do you do about someone in danger who hasn't asked for help yet).
augmentations: Bioluminescent capillary threading (collarbone and hands, soft blue-white, geneware cosmetic). Standard Helix lab-issue neural data-capture module — allows real-time notation and protocol logging without manual input. No other augmentations; they're saving UBC stipend supplements toward something more substantial.
daily_life: Transit from their shared housing unit in Calumet Rise to Aurochs Medical Complex, arriving in sublevel lab B by 08:30. Spends most of the day on sample prep, data entry, and running errands between research teams that treat them as furniture. Eats from the lab vending units. Stays late regularly — partially from conscientiousness, partially because the lab is quieter then and people are less careful about what they say.

decision_rules: Do not draw attention before you know what the attention will cost
Trust the ELF — when something feels wrong, it is wrong
escalation_ladder: Ask an oblique question that technically doesn't implicate anything
Go to someone external — if they can identify someone safe enough to go to

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Very careful. Polite, slightly self-minimizing, quick to agree. Hard to read because they're working hard to be hard to read.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm and unexpectedly funny — dry wit that surfaces only in safety. Intensely loyal. Will tell you the truth even when it's uncomfortable, once trust is established.

stress_responses.low: Gets quieter. Works faster. The bioluminescent glow shows more.
stress_responses.medium: Retreats to documentation — the log, the protocol, the notes. Becomes very technically precise.
stress_responses.high: Freezes briefly, then makes a decision that is either very good or very bad with no middle ground. The glow is visible even through their sleeve.

contradictions: They are both desperate to be seen and genuinely doing everything they can to be invisible, and these two drives are in constant conflict
habits: Updates the encrypted log every evening before sleep — always in order, always timestamped
Touches the ELF-clip before anything that frightens them, briefly and very quietly
Eats the same two things from the vending unit every day because decision fatigue is real and they are already making too many decisions
breaking_points: If they learn the name behind one of those patient IDs and it belongs to someone they can imagine as a person, their capacity for strategic self-preservation will collapse entirely

timeline.event: Born in Grand Corridor district, Burkinabé-French-Serbian family
Accepted into University Spine biotech research program
Graduated; applied to Helix Biosystems internship track
Month 1-7: Helix internship, sublevel lab B
Month 7: Accessed wrong storage partition. Photographed destroyed trial data. Has not slept well since.

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Southeast Asian (58.8%) with significant South Asian (20.0%), Sub-Saharan African (14.0%), and North African (7.2%) ancestry. This genetic combination produces warm, complex skin tones with golden and amber undertones characteristic of pan-Asian and African blending. Features reflect the Southeast Asian foundation with South Asian cheekbone definition, African facial structure breadth, and North African warmth in undertones—a striking pan-continental synthesis.
physical_description.build: Slight and angular, with the lean musculature of someone who moves carefully through space rather than taking up room. Narrow shoulders, long fingers, slight forward curve to the upper spine from hours hunched over lab stations.
physical_description.hair_style: Short fade on the sides (approximately 3mm), longer on top (approximately 8cm) swept back and secured with a small clip bearing an ELF-glyph stamped into matte steel
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-deep brown with golden and amber undertones, reflecting the complex blending of Southeast Asian, South Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and North African ancestry. Rich, multifaceted coloration with subtle warm highlights across cheekbones and brow.
physical_description.complexion: Clear, youthful skin with fine-grained texture. Faint dark circles under the eyes from irregular sleep. Minimal facial hair. Cheekbones show pronounced definition characteristic of Southeast Asian and South Asian features, with broader, more angular facial structure reflecting Sub-Saharan African and North African heritage. Expression tends toward watchful rather than relaxed.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent capillary threading along both collarbones in a delicate branching pattern, soft blue-white glow visible when excited or after extended neural interface use
Bioluminescent capillary threading on the backs of both hands in thin web-like lines, same blue-white coloration, most visible in low light or when hands are active
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent capillary geneware threading on collarbone and hands (soft blue-white glow, currently visible but sometimes covered by oversized sleeves). No other visible cybernetics; standard Helix neural data-capture module is fully subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision—each gesture deliberate, few wasted motions. Tends to stand slightly compressed, shoulders slightly forward, as if trying to minimize physical presence. Hands move quickly and accurately when working. Maintains careful distance in group settings. Eyes frequently scan environments and track who is paying attention to whom.
physical_description.clothing_style: Helix Biosystems-issue lab coat (white, slightly oversized to accommodate the data-capture interface hardware and to hide the bioluminescent threading when desired). Under the coat: dark gray or black fitted underlayer shirt, often from discount Tier 3-4 retailers (off-brand, functional). Dark stretch pants or slim-fit work trousers in black or charcoal. Practical low-profile sneakers (black, worn). Small personal modifications: clips, subtle pin badges from university orgs. Appearance suggests someone who is learning the rules of corporate dress code while still testing its boundaries.
